title: Sports
description: Sports people can train for. Each sport weights the athletic qualities it needs, and the coach favors exercises that build them.

id.description: Stable short id. Saved profiles refer to it, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

qualities.description: How much the sport relies on each quality, from 1 (a little) to 3 (a lot). See exercises.schema.json for what each quality means.
